name: drive-reference-image-bridge
description: Use an exact Google Drive image as a reference for ChatGPT native image generation in an ordinary Chat, without the OpenAI Image API.

interface.shortDescription: Drive image to native ChatGPT image generation
interface.longDescription: Resolve an exact Google Drive image, verify its original bytes, bind it as the current Chat reference image, and invoke ChatGPT native image generation. External image APIs are prohibited.
defaultPrompt: Use an exact image from my Google Drive as the primary reference and generate a new image with ChatGPT native image generation.
드라이브의 정확한 이미지 정본을 참조해서 일반 챗의 이미지 생성 기능으로 새 이미지를 생성해.
